headline: Today's run couldn't open any web pages, so there's no new outside research; the two ideas below build on what the bot already does: a trade countdown and a market breadth check.

ideas.title: Trade budget countdown in the tilt guard
ideas.why: Today the guard only speaks up after trade 9, when the damage is already done. Set a budget in the 08:00 brief (say 5) and get "3 of 5 left" after every new position, with each loss using up one extra. On 25 Oct the budget would have run out early in the revenge run.

ideas.title: Market breadth line at the top of the scanner
ideas.why: Count how many of the scanned movers have 1h EMA 20 above EMA 50 and show "Breadth 70% up" in the scanner and the brief. Flag a short when most of the market is aligned up, or a long when most is aligned down. It reuses klines the scanner already fetches.
